title: Cart Return & Delivery
officialText:
30-Day Easy Returns
Not satisfied? Return eligible items in new, unused condition within 30 days for a refund or exchange. Exclusions apply: clearance, final sale, or used items.
Best Price Guaranteed
COZEWARE will refund the price difference if you find the same item on our website at a lower price within 30 days. Exclusions for bundle offers, clearance items.
Order & Estimated Delivery
An order confirmation email with the Estimated Delivery Date will be sent to your mailbox. You can request to postpone delivery if you are not ready before shipment.
